hero.intro1: We are excited to celebrate this day with you.
hero.intro2: On this page you will find all the important details about the venue, schedule, travel, and RSVP.

welcome.title: A few words before the big day
welcome.copy1: We are looking forward to an elegant, relaxed day with you, surrounded by nature, good conversations, and beautiful moments.
welcome.copy2: Please take a moment to read the information on this page and then let us know via the RSVP form.

items.title: Wedding Party
items.description: A celebratory start to a beautiful evening.

items.title: Brunch Buffet
items.description: Enjoy, chat, and end the day in a relaxed atmosphere.

location.note: You can arrive by train or car. Parking is available on site.

travel.title: Where to stay and how to get there
travel.copy: If you are travelling from further away, you will find suitable overnight options nearby. Feel free to reach out if you have any travel questions.

rsvp.title: Please let us know
rsvp.copy2: Thank you for helping us plan the day.

items.question: What should I wear?
items.answer: Festive, elegant attire with comfortable shoes is a good choice.

items.question: Is there a dress code?
items.answer: There is no strict dress code, but we would love for you to dress elegantly.

items.question: Can I bring a guest?
items.answer: Please check your RSVP details or contact us directly.

footer.line2: We look forward to celebrating with you.
